ops.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object s INNER JOIN t_objectproperties t ON t.Object_ID = s.Object_ID AND t.Property = '505-1 Operation Link' INNER JOIN t_operation p ON p.ea_guid = t.Value INNER JOIN t_object i ON i.Object_ID = p.Object_ID INNER JOIN t_package sp ON sp.Package_ID = s.Package_ID INNER JOIN t_package cp ON cp.Package_ID = sp.Parent_ID WHERE s.Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND i.Name = cp.Name || ' Interface' AND s.Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_operation p INNER JOIN t_object i ON i.Object_ID = p.Object_ID WHERE i.Package_ID = 1127 AND i.Object_Type = 'Interface' AND i.Object_ID <> 11950 AND p.ea_guid NOT IN (SELECT Value FROM t_objectproperties WHERE Property = '505-1 Operation Link')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Stereotype = 'Data Transfer Object' AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object d WHERE d.Stereotype = 'Data Transfer Object' AND d.Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_object q WHERE q.ParentID = d.Object_ID AND q.Name LIKE '%Req') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_object r WHERE r.ParentID = d.Object_ID AND r.Name LIKE '%Res')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type IN ('Object','Component','InteractionOccurrence','MessageEndpoint') AND ParentID = 0 AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Name = 'Object' AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ParentID) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type = 'MessageEndpoint' AND ParentID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165)))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type = 'InteractionOccurrence' AND Classifier = 0 AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS N FROM t_connector WHERE Connector_Type = 'Usage' AND Start_Object_ID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))) AND End_Object_ID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165)))

SELECT s.Object_ID, s.Name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_object l WHERE l.ParentID = s.Object_ID AND l.Object_Type IN ('Object','Component')) AS L, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_object r WHERE r.ParentID = s.Object_ID AND r.Object_Type = 'InteractionOccurrence') AS R, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_connector c INNER JOIN t_diagram d ON c.DiagramID = d.Diagram_ID WHERE d.ParentID = s.Object_ID AND c.Connector_Type = 'Sequence') AS M FROM t_object s WHERE s.Stereotype = 'Service Realization' AND s.Package_ID IN (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Parent_ID IN (1130,1131,1155,1156,1157,1158,1159,1160,1161,1162,1163,1164,1165))
